activation.note: owner-supplied key; phone activation is the only remaining path and is not repeatable

constraints: ide disk only, no ahci/sata, no virtio: the disk bus is a hard constraint, not a preference
no tls 1.2 and no modern cipher suites: every https call terminates on the host, plain http or files only
smb1 only: file transfer must not rely on a modern share
32-bit address space under 4gb: no large fixtures in memory
no security updates since 2014-04: ephemeral by default and never credentialed
usb passthrough is fragile on pc/i440fx: prefer file-in-out over device bridges
